title: Bounded constructible derived-complete integral coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell\neq p$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and a scheme $Y$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\geq1$.
Let $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ be the full subcategory of
$D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, the derived category of the completed
integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], whose
objects $K$ are derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete] and satisfy

$$
 K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\in D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})
$$

for every $n\geq1$, where $K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ is the derived reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] (the derived tensor product over $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ with $(A_{E,n})_Y$), and $D^b_c(Y,A_{E,n})\subset D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ is the category of bounded
complexes satisfying the finite-torsion constructibility condition
[def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. In
addition we require that the cohomological supports
[def-weil-cohomological-support]

$$
 \operatorname{Supp}_{\mathrm{coh}}
 \bigl(K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}\bigr)
$$

are contained in a single interval $[r,s]$ of $\mathbf Z$ with $r\leq s$
independent of $n$. This uniform amplitude of the reductions is part of the
definition of $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, and it is the only boundedness
condition imposed on them. That this full subcategory is a triangulated subcategory (contains $0$, closed under isomorphisms, shifts and extensions in distinguished triangles) is a separate statement, not part of this definition.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against the blueprint (master; no slopmaster2 copy of this node) and Bhatt-Scholze Def. 6.5.1 / Stacks Tag 09C2-type definitions. Two changes. (1) The definition asserted 'full triangulated subcategory', which is a claim, not a definition: it now defines the full subcategory, and the claim is the new statement node lem-weil-integral-constructible-triangulated (source Bhatt-Scholze §6.5 after Def. 6.5.1, Stacks Tag 0999), which depends on this node; users needing the triangulated structure must cite it. (2) The reduction K⊗^L_{O_E}A_{E,n} was attributed to def-weil-derived-tensor, which only defines the derived tensor over a constant ring sheaf A_Y; here the ring sheaf Ô_{E,Y} is not constant and the result must land in D(Y_proet,A_{E,n}). It now points to the new definition node def-weil-integral-derived-reduction (K-flat resolution over Ô_{E,Y}, then change of rings to (A_{E,n})_Y via def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product), and def-weil-derived-tensor was removed from stmt_deps. The fixed data (ℓ, E, ϖ_E, Y, A_{E,n}) are now introduced in the statement. Mathlib: FullSubcategory, DerivedCategory, SheafOfModules and ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated exist; derived reduction, derived completeness and constructibility do not.
